title: P8-D desktop preflight after repeated reported unlock
trigger: The user reported unlocking the macOS session after the previous P8-D preflight failed.

screenCapture.result: Failed: could not create image from display.

retryAfterReportedUnlock.trigger: The user reported that the macOS session was being unlocked.
retryAfterReportedUnlock.result: Failed: could not create image from display.

retryAfterFurtherReportedUnlock.trigger: The user again reported unlocking the macOS session.
retryAfterFurtherReportedUnlock.result: Failed: could not create image from display.

coreGraphicsDisplayState.command: swift -module-cache-path /private/tmp/swift-module-cache -e 'import CoreGraphics; var count: UInt32 = 0; let result = CGGetActiveDisplayList(0, nil, &count); print("first=\(result) activeCount=\(count)")'
coreGraphicsDisplayState.interpretation: The current process sees no active Quartz display. This does not establish whether the user's physical login session is locked or whether TCC screen-capture permission is granted.

coreGraphicsDisplayStateAfterFurtherUnlo.command: swift -module-cache-path /private/tmp/swift-module-cache -e 'import CoreGraphics; var count: UInt32 = 0; let result = CGGetActiveDisplayList(0, nil, &count); print("result=\(result) activeCount=\(count)")'
coreGraphicsDisplayStateAfterFurtherUnlo.interpretation: The process still sees no active Quartz display after the further reported unlock. This does not diagnose the user's physical login state or screen-capture permissions.

retryAfterLatestReportedUnlock.interpretation: This process still has no active Quartz display and cannot capture the desktop. The result does not establish whether the physical login session is locked.

retryAfterLatestUnlockMessage.screenCaptureResult: Failed: could not create image from display.
retryAfterLatestUnlockMessage.coreGraphicsCommand: swift -module-cache-path /private/tmp/swift-module-cache -e 'import CoreGraphics; var count: UInt32 = 0; let result = CGGetActiveDisplayList(0, nil, &count); print("result=\(result) activeCount=\(count)")'
retryAfterLatestUnlockMessage.interpretation: After this unlock report, the process still sees no active Quartz display and cannot capture a desktop image. Retry only after active-display detection and capture both work.

disposition.nextTrigger: The current process reports at least one active Quartz display and screencapture successfully creates an image; an unlock report without those changed conditions is not a retry trigger.
disposition.nextAction: Once display capture works, launch the explicit LibreCAD 2 bundle path, complete the Move/Copy action-boundary and named-LTYPE checks, then run the LibreCAD_3 MPOLYGON round trip if that application becomes available.
